name: FastSpring
notes: Derived from FastSpring's embedded/popup storefront — validate on first use.

steps.addToCart: Popup or embedded storefront; add item → checkout.
steps.billing: Email + address in FastSpring's own form (merchant of record).
steps.payment: FastSpring's own card inputs (not Stripe): input[name*=ccNumber], expiry first, then the card-number token, then the CVV token into input[name*=cvv] / input[autocomplete=cc-csc] immediately after.
